scope: Read-only verification that candidate-decision source v3 corrects the v2 event-label interpretation while preserving the reviewed source and patch. No compile, solver, model, raw TAPE3 scan, or raw trace read was performed.

semantic_finding.v2_description: LNCOR1_9 was labeled as having survived LNCOR1 filters and reached CNVFNV.
semantic_finding.source_location: In v3 candidate oprop.f90, SP and SPPSP are calculated at lines 1262-1264; the reason-9 event is emitted immediately at lines 1265-1274. The later IFLAG=0 SPEAK/FREJ tests begin at lines 1280 onward and can reject the row with a jump to label 25. CNVFNV is a separate routine and has phase-3 hooks.
semantic_finding.v3_interpretation: LNCOR1_9 reports that corrected SP/SPPSP strength was computed before downstream SPEAK/FREJ filtering. It does not report that those later filters passed or that CNVFNV was entered. A same-identity phase-3 CNVFNV event is the evidence for CNVFNV entry.
semantic_finding.assessment: The plan and README now describe the exact hook position and do not overstate acceptance. The candidate source hook itself is unchanged from v2.

change_scope.metadata_only_correction: The reason-9 semantics are corrected in plan and README; isotope decoding and encoded-MOL fixes from v2 are retained. No source hook was moved or added.

limitations: The candidate remains uncompiled and unrun; this review does not establish compiler/ABI behavior or runtime ledger completeness.
Even a complete source-decision ledger cannot establish that a physical cancellation partner ought to exist or that negative optical depth is physically valid.
disposition: The v2 reason-9 wording blocker is corrected in v3 without changing the candidate source or patch. Preserve all earlier v1/v2 plans and reviews unchanged.
